These frozen synthetic fixtures preserve the installer smoke test inputs while
keeping its runtime free of Pillow, ReportLab and QR-generation dependencies.

- `email.png`: original 760×190 smoke fixture, generated with Pillow 12.3.0's
  default 20px font. Contains two synthetic email addresses and one lookalike.
- `email.pdf`: the same image encoded with Pillow at 150 dpi, as in the previous
  installer test. This independent input is not generated by the scanner under test.
- `qr.png`: Segno 1.6.6, payload `MCP smoke`, ordinary QR, scale 6.

No real personal data. Tests write copies and results into temporary directories.
